cohort: 3001 deliveries, including 44 cases of ruptured uterus
finding: The prevalence of ruptured uterus was high (14.7/1000 deliveries), particularly among women with prolonged/obstructed labor and previous cesarean section, and was associated with high perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was a risk factor for uterine rupture, occurring in 23 (56.1%) of cases.
